title: Sable Medium Pebbled Leather Backpack
description_html:
Sable Medium Pebbled Leather Backpack by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 9.75”W X 12.75”H X 5.25”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 1.75"
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
